extraction_notes: The datasheet contains usable output and transfer plots on p. 3; points were digitized from the plotted traces without interpolation between unrelated traces.
No capacitance-versus-VDS figure is published; only maximum Ciss, Coss, and Crss table values are available.
Fig. 3 has an unlabeled trace-to-VGS mapping and an axis printed in A with numeric ticks extending to 1500, so it was not used as a quantitative RDS(on) extraction.
The datasheet publishes no typical RDS(on) curve values in the required table fields beyond the two tabulated conditions; both typical and maximum table entries are preserved.

The datasheet publishes no thermal RthJC or RthJA value in the schema-supported specification fields; the p. 1 RthetaJA maximum of 357 degC/W is noted in the source but not represented by this schema.
The datasheet publishes no gate-charge Qg value in the schema-supported specification fields; switching table values are not represented by this schema.
IDSS maximum is 1.0 uA at VDS = 60 V and VGS = 0 V, but IDSS is not a schema-supported specification field.
